npc.daycare.pickPokemon1: Hello - I'm a professional Pokemon breeder. You can leave a Pokemon with me and I'll take care of it while you go on your adventure!
npc.daycare.pickPokemon2: I can also help it grow if you choose to leave it with me for a while. I'll ask for a small fee when you come to pick it up, but it's worth it to see it grow strong and healthy!

npc.shopkeeper.welcome: Welcome! What can I get you?
npc.abilitiesSwap.intro1: Pokémon carry genetic traits that shape how they fight. Most express only one dominant ability — but with the right technology, a hidden one can be brought to the surface.
npc.abilitiesSwap.intro2: Every Pokémon holds more potential than it shows. I've spent years studying how to shift which ability takes dominance. It's precise work — but I can do it.
npc.abilitiesSwap.intro3: Abilities aren't learned — they're inherited. But inheritance isn't always destiny. With my equipment, I can coax a different trait to the forefront.
npc.abilitiesSwap.intro4: So — which Pokémon shall we work on today?
npc.abilitiesSwap.noOptions: This Pokémon has already reached its full potential. There is nothing more I can offer.
npc.abilitiesSwap.confirm: I can awaken {ability} in {name}. It will cost {cost}₽. Shall I proceed?
npc.abilitiesSwap.cancelled: Very well. Come back if you change your mind.
npc.abilitiesSwap.noMoney: You don't have enough money. You need {cost}₽ for this.
npc.abilitiesSwap.success: {name} has awakened {ability}! May it serve you well.
